This is not a picture frame! It is a flat board with a small (1/4") magnetic sticker on it. An even tinier magnet fits on top of that sticker and you're supposed to attach your photo to the flat board with this tiny magnet. Anyone who has ever hung photos on the fridge with a magnet knows the photo will warp when it's not held flat! The tiny magnet is easy to drop and lose, and is a choking hazard. The sticker was placed at a random spot on the board and I had to peel it off (it was REALLY stuck on there) and reposition it, and then clean off the residue it left behind. Both the images and description are misleading (the images hide the magnet backing and put a shadow around the photos as in a frame, which this is not.) Finally, the flower image in the top corner is cut off. I can't give this as a gift!
